import numpy as np

B = np.array(
    [
        [1, 1, 0, 0],
        [1, 1, 1, 0],
        [0, 1, 1, 1],
        [0, 0, 1, 1],
    ],
    dtype=float,
)

gram = B @ B.T
R = gram - np.diag(np.diag(gram))
D_R = np.diag(R.sum(axis=1))
L_R = D_R - R

B, R, L_R
